title: SIDE STORY: THE GREAT CHIEF RETURNS RERUN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: THE GREAT CHIEF RETURNS RERUN
EVENT DURATION: February 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – February 18, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: The Great Chief Returns event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
[Great Chief’s Path] Duration: February 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – February 14, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Gavial’s Footprints] Duration: February 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – February 14, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[THE BRAVE’ S TRIALS]
DURATION: February 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – February 18, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can complete missions in the Brave’s Trials by clearing event stages. Additionally, players can obtain the special furniture Warchief’s Throne as a reward by completing specific missions.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Tomimi, Tribal Inn Furniture (Pieces), Mechanical Parts.
[INAM COMMITTEE]
DURATION: February 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – February 18, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Mechanical Parts by clearing event stages and the Brave’s Trials. Mechanical Parts can be used to redeem items from Inam Committee.
MAIN REWARDS: Tomimi's Token, Tribal Inn Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Battle Records, Elite Materials, etc.
NOTE:

The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Exchange Info] for more details.
[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemables will be added.
Operators Eunectes, Tomimi, Flint, and Aciddrop will gain more trust during the event rerun.
After the event rerun ends, this event will be archived into [Side Story] and become permanently available.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – HEART OF STEEL: THE RAGING IRONHIDE
DURATION: February 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – February 18, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Heart of Steel: The Raging Ironhide", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Eunectes
★★★★★: Flint / Meteorite
★★★★: Aciddrop
